name: document-design
description: Design system for documentation and report pages, and the site that presents it

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:site
scripts.check: node scripts/check-lockfile.mjs && node scripts/check-design-md.mjs && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:pages: npm run build && npm run build:storybook && node scripts/pages.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:ui && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
